card: Fixes an off-by-one check in contrib/seeds/makeseeds.py by requiring at least 12 fields instead of 11 before reading the user agent at index 11. Previously, any seeder input line containing exactly 11 fields caused an unhandled IndexError that crashed the seed generator rather than skipping the line. This prevents aborted runs when processing truncated crawler downloads or mixed seeder output formats. The change is isolated to a single line in a release-generation maintenance tool.
changed_since_previous: Dropped the unit tests that were added in the previous version, leaving only the one-line fix in contrib/seeds/makeseeds.py.
evidence: Commit message: "A truncated line with exactly 11 fields therefore raised IndexError and aborted the run after the asmap database was loaded. Require all 12 fields so truncated lines are skipped."

PR description: "README.md builds seeds_main.txt by appending one crawler's output onto another's, so the file mixes two independently maintained formats, and a truncated download leaves a short last line too. Skipping the line is what the check was already trying to do."
Linked issue #36146: "contrib: makeseeds.py parseline() raises IndexError on lines with exactly 11 fields"
problem: When parsing DNS seeder records, `parseline()` skipped lines with fewer than 11 fields but subsequently read `sline[11]` (the 12th element). A truncated or malformed record with exactly 11 fields passed the length guard and triggered an unhandled `IndexError`, aborting the seed generation script instead of ignoring the line.

risk.why: The change affects only an offline seed generation maintenance script and cannot impact node operation or release binaries directly.

summary: Fixes an off-by-one error in the minimum field count check of `contrib/seeds/makeseeds.py`. The parser now checks that an input line contains at least 12 whitespace-separated fields before accessing index 11 for the user agent.
